_comment: Save templates for tests/scenarios/*.txt, built by tools/scenarios.py saves into build/scenarios/saves/NAME.
from: parent template (null = empty save dir). script: input lines (list) or a file in tests/scenarios/saves/.
seconds: when the builder quits the game. slot: the SAVEGAME slot that patch applies to (default 4).
patch: {address: int (little-endian dword) or string (raw bytes)}, address = guest VA, file offset = address - 0x455620.
check: {slot, stage, room, name, account, day, month, year, hour, minute, "0xADDRESS": dword} asserted after the build (a list for several slots).
Order: copy the parent, run the script, delete W_DEBUG.DAT, copy_slot, patch, check.

cd_missing.note: An empty save dir with a CDROM.LOC that points to a CD drive that does not exist, so the start-up CD check fails and opens CD_NOT_FOUND_DLG.

s1base.note: New game, saved at once in the stage-1 town (about 7:40, account 500) as 'Base' in slot 4.

s1town10.note: Stage-1 town at 10:00 (all places open), account 20000.

s1fbi.note: FBI countdown 0x455831 = 40: FBI car in town, Dealer Don always in the bar.

s1rich.note: Account 70000: buying Don's identity ends stage 1.

s1rentfbi.note: Rent 0x455740 = 4 h, FBI countdown 40, 0x455799 = 40 (motel: 'Pay the rental first!', blackmail, rent reminder).

s1partner.note: 0x455791 = 1 (Lula wants a partner), rent 30 h (chicken farm sign-up).

s1chick.note: 0x45583d = 1: one more bird kill pays the $500 reward.

s1late.note: Clock 23:50 (day end a few seconds after loading).

stage1_goal.note: Stage-1 save patched so that the stage-1 end check passes on loading (account 60000, flags 0x455841/0x455845 = 1).

stage2.note: Loading stage1_goal switches to the stage-2 office (8:00, account 60000); saved by the game as 'Stage2'.

stage2_rich.note: Account 2500000 and clock 18:55: the day end switches to stage 3.

stage2_movie.note: Movie record 0 (0x455aa1) = finished movie 'TestMovie' (state +0x14c = 3, some quality values 60), movie count 0x457b49 = 1.

stage3.note: The game itself reaches stage 3 (Los Angeles realtor, room 6, 2-1-1997) and saves it as 'Stage3'.

s2bust.note: Account -100000 (credit line 70000), 18:30, one game minute per tick.

s2month.note: Sunday 1-30-1997 19:00 (month change at the next day end).

s2year.note: Sunday 12-30-1997 18:00, one game minute per tick (year change at the next day end).

s2fast.note: stage2 with one game minute per 60 ms tick (0x4556bc = 0, four times the normal speed).

s2fast_sunday.note: s2fast moved to Sunday 1-7-1997 15:30 (weekday 6), the input of sim2.

sim2.note: Saved by the game in the stage-2 overview as 'Sim2' after the clock ran a while; the clock is then set to 17:08. Stands in for the explorers' sim2, which the 6-day run build/explore/simulation/scripts/L3.txt wrote.

mkt2.note: stage2 with the marketing office rented, saved in the marketing building (room 31) as 'Mkt2'.

office1.note: New game, motel room rented, saved in the motel room (room 5, stage 1) as 'Office1' in slot 1.

s1flag.note: Slot 1 patched with account 120000 and flags 0x455841/0x455845 = 1: loading it switches to the stage-2 office.

s1flag3.note: Slot 1 patched with account 2500000, the stage-1 goal flags and clock 18:40: stage 2 at once, stage 3 at the 19:00 day end.

s1room10.note: Slot 1 patched to 10:00 and account 20000 (input of s1eq).

s1eq.note: Photo equipment bought at the Video store, saved in the motel room as 'Equipped' in slot 2.

s2cast.note: Stage 2 with the casting office rented, saved in the casting office (room 21) as 'Casting2' in slot 2.

s2cast9.note: Slot 2 clock set back to 9:05 (input of s2lula).

s2lula.note: Lula's flat rented, saved there (room 23) as 'LulaFlat' in slot 3.

s3office.note: The game goes from stage 1 through stage 2 to stage 3, buys the mansion and saves the stage-3 office (room 5) as 'Mansion3' in slot 2.

s3party.note: Slot 2 with a weekly party plan (0x45d191 = 5, buffet 20, girls 36, last party 3-1-1997), clock 20:45, fastest game speed (0x4556bc = 1).

s3b.note: The secretary's present opened, saved as 'Mansion3b' in slot 3.

store3.note: A 'Little junk store' rented in the Los Angeles suburbs (7800 $ a month, $50000 startup capital; the store on offer depends on the random city data, see LULA_CLOCK), saved on the city map (room 1) as 'Store3' in slot 4.

s3broke.note: Tuesday 21:00, one game minute per tick, store capital 500 $ (the store record of store3 starts at 0x45cc69: 0x45cc75 rent 7800, 0x45cc81 capital; the explorers' store sat at 0x45cf15, the record depends on the random city data).

s3month.note: Store3 on the last day of January (the game's months have 30 days), a Sunday (weekday 0x4556b8 = 6), at 20:40: the stage-3 day end at 22:00 starts a new month (0x422bf8, day == 1) and a new week (0x422de5, weekday == 0).
